# Dr. VedPati Mishra Institute Of Scholars (VMIS)

> डॉ. वेदपति मिश्र इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ स्कॉलर्स — a CBSE-oriented school in Handia, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, India. Motto: तत्वमसि.

- Levels offered (12): Nursery, Prep, LKG, UKG, Class I, II, III, IV, V, VI, VII, VIII.
- Stages: Early Years (Nursery–UKG), Primary (Classes I–V), Upper Primary (Classes VI–VIII).
- Languages: English (/en) and Hindi (/hi).
- CBSE affiliation details are published only after verification: /en/cbse-approach and /en/public-disclosure.
